Wanted? Shit, back when I had a car I called that a Sunday afternoon. I'd get baked after waking up, cook a nice, big breakfast and gobble it down, then pack a lunch, pick a direction, and a time limit, and just go. Any brown signs marking land marks or state parks were usually followed, I'd pick somewhere with a nice view to enjoy my lunch and a beer or two, and smoke blunts the whole way. Back roads were best. Sure, most were gravel, but you could usually go as fast as you dared and cops were practically non-existent.

I did have a run in with a county officer once, but he was an old dude and we were in the middle of nowhere. I had smoked my last blunt and was obviously baked, with one half empty beer in hand and a full one in the cooler. I never told him I was high, the weed was all gone, but I offered him my last beer and a cigarette. Dude took both and we had a long chat about the county. He pointed me in the direction of a nice local spot to take in the sights, I went, wound up by a bend in the river with a great sunset and a peaceful stand of woods.

Not all cops are nice, but it's always great to find one who's old enough to know when something isn't worth the time or effort.
